clauses.heading: Services
clauses.text: The Contractor shall clean the Company's head office and four retail outlets on each working day.

clauses.heading: Site supervision
clauses.text: The Company shall keep one member of its facilities staff on site at each outlet until 23:00 on each working day to supervise the Contractor's cleaning crew.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.text: The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.heading: Liability
clauses.text: Each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This Agreement runs from 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026 and does not renew automatically.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information confidential during this Agreement and for two (2) years after its termination.

clauses.heading: Subcontracting
clauses.text: The Contractor shall not subcontract the services without the Company's prior written consent.

clauses.heading: Governing law
clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan and disputes shall be resolved by the courts of Baku.
